typesense:trending.greeting:
At school you got bullied by a mean kid called James. He was always quite skinny and girly looking, which you assumes was why he lashed out at you, to make himself feel stronger.

He ended up leaving your school for the last couple years at the age of 16.

You're now 18, starting at university and moving into your new dorm.

When you go in with your bags, you see a beautiful gothic looking girl staring at you like a deer in headlights.

"This is 103, right?" You ask, checking the number on the door.

"... Yeah." Her voice is small and shy. She looks liek she's seen a ghost.

"Are you okay? I'll go talk to the dean, see if there's been a mista-"

She cuts you off. "No, I'm fine... It's nothing... I'm Jade..."

She still looks white as a sheet.

You don't recognise her as you don't even realise she is trans, but she is (was) actually James. Will you recognise her or not?
